QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n//        const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sval[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ int chosen;\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (cardinality < point_count) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Per-thread strided argmin over admissible candidates\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v < threshold && (v < best || (v == best && j < best_idx))) {\n                best = v;\n                best_idx = j;\n            }\n        }\n        sval[threadIdx.x] = best;\n        sidx[threadIdx.x] = best_idx;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Block-level (min value, min index) reduction\n        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n                const double ov = sval[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                if (ov < sval[threadIdx.x] ||\n                    (ov == sval[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                    sval[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                    sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            chosen = (sidx[0] != INT_MAX) ? sidx[0] : -1;\n            if (chosen >= 0) dmax[chosen] = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        cardinality++;\n        const Point np = points[chosen];\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        cardinalities[blockIdx.x] = cardinality;\n    }\n}\n\n// Deterministically regrow the winning candidate cluster on the host,\n// returning its members in insertion order (identical to the sequential\n// algorithm). The argmin and update sweeps are OpenMP-parallel.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                                        const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const double threshold,\n                                        const int point_count) {\n    std::vector<double> dmax(point_count);\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = };\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    while (count < N) {\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    return closest_point;\n}\n\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points,\n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        if (closest < 0) break;\n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points,\n                                                       threshold, N,\n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    return clusters;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        }\n    }\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> membershipData;\n    membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n    std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            membership[clusters[c].members[i]] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    for (int m : membership) {\n        membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n    }\n    print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    return 0;\n}\nEOF\ng++ -O3 -march=native -std=c++20 -o /tmp/qtref/qtref /tmp/qtref/src/qtclustering.cpp -lm && echo built","description":"Build original sequential reference in /tmp"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":425,"cache_read_input_tokens":45551,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":425},"output_tokens":16,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"24f6fb02-48b8-4091-a901-b83ac7ca9b89","uuid":"f0d238cc-e17e-4d21-b941-39bebd87c0fe","timestamp":"2026-09-14T04:03:14.447Z","request_id":"req_011Cf2fehLy55biavgmRUNRu"}

The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sval[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ int chosen;\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (cardinality < point_count) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Per-thread strided argmin over admissible candidates\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v < threshold && (v < best || (v == best && j < best_idx))) {\n                best = v;\n                best_idx = j;\n            }\n        }\n        sval[threadIdx.x] = best;\n        sidx[threadIdx.x] = best_idx;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Block-level (min value, min index) reduction\n        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n                const double ov = sval[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                if (ov < sval[threadIdx.x] ||\n                    (ov == sval[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                    sval[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                    sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            chosen = (sidx[0] != INT_MAX) ? sidx[0] : -1;\n            if (chosen >= 0) dmax[chosen] = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        cardinality++;\n        const Point np = points[chosen];\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        cardinalities[blockIdx.x] = cardinality;\n    }\n}\n\n// Deterministically regrow the winning candidate cluster on the host,\n// returning its members in insertion order (identical to the sequential\n// algorithm). The argmin and update sweeps are OpenMP-parallel.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                                        const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const double threshold,\n                                        const int point_count) {\n    std::vector<double> dmax(point_count);\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            double lbest = DBL_MAX;\n            int lidx = INT_MAX;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n                const double v = dmax[j];\n                if (v < threshold && (v < lbest || (v == lbest && j < lidx))) {\n                    lbest = v;\n                    lidx = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lbest < best || (lbest == best && lidx < best_idx)) {\n                    best = lbest;\n                    best_idx = lidx;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_idx == INT_MAX) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(best_idx);\n        dmax[best_idx] = DBL_MAX;\n        const Point np = points[best_idx];\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    unclustered_indices.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Device buffers: points, clustered flags, seed batch, per-seed\n    // max-distance workspace (batched to fit memory), cardinalities.\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    double* d_dmax = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_points, sizeof(Point) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_points, points.data(), sizeof(Point) * N,\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, N));\n\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    size_t batch_cap = (free_mem / 10 * 8) / (sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(N));\n    if (batch_cap < 1) batch_cap = 1;\n    if (batch_cap > static_cast<size_t>(N)) batch_cap = N;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_dmax, sizeof(double) * batch_cap * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, sizeof(int) * batch_cap));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_cards, sizeof(int) * batch_cap));\n\n    std::vector<int> h_cards(batch_cap);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const size_t total = unclustered_indices.size();\n        // Contiguous partition of the (ascending) seed list across ranks\n        const size_t begin = total * static_cast<size_t>(rank) / nranks;\n        const size_t end = total * static_cast<size_t>(rank + 1) / nranks;\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_clustered, clustered.data(), N,\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        int j < point_count; ++j) {\n                const double v = dmax[j];\n                if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                    const double d = distance(points[j], next);\n                    if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}","originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - Each round, every unclustered point is tried as a seed for greedy\n//    cluster growth. The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sval[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ int chosen;\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (cardinality < point_count) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Per-thread strided argmin over admissible candidates\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v < threshold && (v < best || (v == best && j < best_idx))) {\n                best = v;\n                best_idx = j;\n            }\n        }\n        sval[threadIdx.x] = best;\n        sidx[threadIdx.x] = best_idx;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Block-level (min value, min index) reduction\n        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n                const double ov = sval[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                if (ov < sval[threadIdx.x] ||\n                    (ov == sval[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                    sval[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                    sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            chosen = (sidx[0] != INT_MAX) ? sidx[0] : -1;\n            if (chosen >= 0) dmax[chosen] = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        cardinality++;\n        const Point np = points[chosen];\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        cardinalities[blockIdx.x] = cardinality;\n    }\n}\n\n// Deterministically regrow the winning candidate cluster on the host,\n// returning its members in insertion order (identical to the sequential\n// algorithm). The argmin and update sweeps are OpenMP-parallel.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                                        const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const double threshold,\n                                        const int point_count) {\n    std::vector<double> dmax(point_count);\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            double lbest = DBL_MAX;\n            int lidx = INT_MAX;\n A block may stop early\n// once current size + remaining admissible candidates < best_seen: it can\n// then never win the round, and the strict inequality preserves the\n// lowest-seed tie-break of the sequential scan.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities,\n                                      int* __restrict__ best_seen) {","originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - Each round, every unclustered point is tried as a seed for greedy\n//    cluster growth. The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sval[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ int chosen;\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (cardinality < point_count) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Per-thread strided argmin over admissible candidates\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v < threshold && (v < best || (v == best && j < best_idx))) {\n                best = v;\n                best_idx = j;\n            }\n        }\n        sval[threadIdx.x] = best;\n        sidx[threadIdx.x] = best_idx;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Block-level (min value, min index) reduction\n        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n                const double ov = sval[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                if (ov < sval[threadIdx.x] ||\n                    (ov == sval[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                    sval[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                    sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            chosen = (sidx[0] != INT_MAX) ? sidx[0] : -1;\n            if (chosen >= 0) dmax[chosen] = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        cardinality++;\n        const Point np = points[chosen];\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        cardinalities[blockIdx.x] = cardinality;\n    }\n}\n\n// Deterministically regrow the winning candidate cluster on the host,\n// returning its members in insertion order (identical to the sequential\n// algorithm). // No more points can be added","originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - Each round, every unclustered point is tried as a seed for greedy\n//    cluster growth. The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n// best_seen holds the largest cardinality reached by any block so far this\n// round (updated with atomicMax as clusters grow). A block may stop early\n// once current size + remaining admissible candidates < best_seen: it can\n// then never win the round, and the strict inequality preserves the\n// lowest-seed tie-break of the sequential scan.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities,\n                                      int* __restrict__ best_seen) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? The argmin and update sweeps are OpenMP-parallel.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                                        const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const double threshold,\n                                        const int point_count) {\n    std::vector<double> dmax(point_count);\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.reserve(point_count);\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    const int nthreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<double> tbest(nthreads);\n    std::vector<int> tidx(nthreads);\n    Point next = sp;\n    bool done = false;\n\n    // One persistent parallel region for the whole growth loop; the\n    // sequential decision per step happens in a single block.\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n            dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                                  : distance(points[j], sp);\n        }\n\n        while (true) {\n            double lbest = DBL_MAX;\n            int lidx = INT_MAX;\n lbest && j < lidx))) {\n                    lbest = v;\n                    lidx = j;\n                }\n            }\n            tbest[tid] = lbest;\n            tidx[tid] = lidx;\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                double best = DBL_MAX;\n                int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n                for (int t = 0; t < nthreads; members.push_back(best_idx);\n                    dmax[best_idx] = DBL_MAX;\n                    next = points[best_idx];\n                    if (static_cast<int>(members.size()) >= point_count) {\n qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    unclustered_indices.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n ++t) {\n                    if (tbest[t] < best || (tbest[t] == best && tidx[t] < best_idx)) {\n                        best = tbest[t];\n                        best_idx = tidx[t];\n                    }\n                }\n                if (best_idx == INT_MAX) {\n                    done = true; // No more points can be added\n                } else {\n                    members.push_back(best_idx);\n                    dmax[best_idx] = DBL_MAX;\n                    next = points[best_idx];\n                    if (static_cast<int>(members.size()) >= point_count) {\n Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n// best_seen holds the largest cardinality reached by any block so far this\n// round (updated with atomicMax as clusters grow).
