The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n// best_seen holds the largest cardinality reached by any block so far this\n// round (updated with atomicMax as clusters grow). A block may stop early\n// once current size + remaining admissible candidates < best_seen: it can\n// then never win the round, and the strict inequality preserves the\n// lowest-seed tie-break of the sequential scan.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities,\n                                      int* __restrict__ best_seen) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sval[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ int scnt[TPB];\n    __shared__ int chosen;\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (cardinality < point_count) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Per-thread strided argmin + admissible count over candidates\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v < threshold) {\n                cnt++;\n                if (v < best || (v == best && j < best_idx)) {\n                    best = v;\n                    best_idx = j;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        sval[threadIdx.x] = best;\n        sidx[threadIdx.x] = best_idx;\n        scnt[threadIdx.x] = cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Block-level (min value, min index) and sum reduction\n        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n                const double ov = sval[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                if (ov < sval[threadIdx.x] ||\n                    (ov == sval[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                    sval[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                    sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                }\n                scnt[threadIdx.x] += scnt[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            const int prev_best = atomicMax(best_seen, cardinality);\n            if (cardinality + scnt[0] < max(prev_best, cardinality)) {\n                chosen = -1; // Cannot win this round; stop early\n            } else {\n                chosen = (sidx[0] != INT_MAX) ? sidx[0] : -1;\n            }\n            if (chosen >= 0) dmax[chosen] = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        cardinality++;\n        const Point np = points[chosen];\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        cardinalities[blockIdx.x] = cardinality;\n    }\n}\n\n// Deterministically regrow the winning candidate cluster on the host,\n// returning its members in insertion order (identical to the sequential\n// algorithm). The argmin and update sweeps are OpenMP-parallel.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                                        const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const double threshold,\n                                        const int point_count) {\n    std::vector<double> dmax(point_count);\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.reserve(point_count);\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    const int nthreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<double> tbest(nthreads);\n    std::vector<int> tidx(nthreads);\n    Point next = sp;\n    bool done = false;\n\n    // One persistent parallel region for the whole growth loop; the\n    // sequential decision per step happens in a single block.\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n            dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                                  : distance(points[j], sp);\n        }\n\n        while (true) {\n            double lbest = DBL_MAX;\n            int lidx = INT_MAX;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n                const double v = dmax[j];\n                if (v < threshold && (v < lbest || (v == lbest && j < lidx))) {\n                    lbest = v;\n                    lidx = j;\n                }\n            }\n            tbest[tid] = lbest;\n            tidx[tid] = lidx;\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                double best = DBL_MAX;\n                int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n                for (int t = 0; t < nthreads; ++t) {\n                    if (tbest[t] < best || (tbest[t] == best && tidx[t] < best_idx)) {\n                        best = tbest[t];\n                        best_idx = tidx[t];\n                    }\n                }\n                if (best_idx == INT_MAX) {\n                    done = true; // No more points can be added\n                } else {\n                    members.push_back(best_idx);\n                    dmax[best_idx] = DBL_MAX;\n                    next = points[best_idx];\n                    if (static_cast<int>(members.size()) >= point_count) {\n                        done = true;\n                    }\n                }\n            } // implicit barrier\n\n            if (done) break;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n                const double v = dmax[j];\n                if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                    const double d = distance(points[j], next);\n                    if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n// best_seen holds the largest cardinality reached by any block so far this\n// round (updated with atomicMax as clusters grow). A block may stop early\n// once current size + remaining admissible candidates < best_seen: it can\n// then never win the round, and the strict inequality preserves the\n// lowest-seed tie-break of the sequential scan.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities,\n                                      int* __restrict__ best_seen) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sval[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ int scnt[TPB];\n    __shared__ int chosen;\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (cardinality < point_count) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Per-thread strided argmin + admissible count over candidates\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v < threshold) {\n                cnt++;\n                if (v < best || (v == best && j < best_idx)) {\n                    best = v;\n                    best_idx = j;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        sval[threadIdx.x] = best;\n        sidx[threadIdx.x] = best_idx;\n        scnt[threadIdx.x] = cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Block-level (min value, min index) and sum reduction\n        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n                const double ov = sval[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                if (ov < sval[threadIdx.x] ||\n                    (ov == sval[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                    sval[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                    sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                }\n                scnt[threadIdx.x] += scnt[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            const int prev_best = atomicMax(best_seen, cardinality);\n            if (cardinality + scnt[0] < max(prev_best, cardinality)) {\n                chosen = -1; // Cannot win this round; stop early\n            } else {\n                chosen = (sidx[0] != INT_MAX) ? sidx[0] : -1;\n            }\n            if (chosen >= 0) dmax[chosen] = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        cardinality++;\n        const Point np = points[chosen];\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        cardinalities[blockIdx.x] = cardinality;\n    }\n}\n\n// Deterministically regrow the winning candidate cluster on the host,\n// returning its members in insertion order (identical to the sequential\n// algorithm). The argmin and update sweeps are OpenMP-parallel.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                                        const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const double threshold,\n                                        const int point_count) {\n    std::vector<double> dmax(point_count);\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.reserve(point_count);\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    const int nthreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<double> tbest(nthreads);\n    std::vector<int> tidx(nthreads);\n    Point next = sp;\n    bool done = false;\n\n    // One persistent parallel region for the whole growth loop; the\n    // sequential decision per step happens in a single block.\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n            dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                                  : distance(points[j], sp);\n        }\n\n        while (true) {\n            double lbest = DBL_MAX;\n            int lidx = INT_MAX;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n                const double v = dmax[j];\n                if (v < threshold && (v < lbest || (v == lbest && j < lidx))) {\n                    lbest = v;\n                    lidx = j;\n                }\n            }\n            tbest[tid] = lbest;\n            tidx[tid] = lidx;\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                double best = DBL_MAX;\n                int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n                for (int t = 0; t < nthreads; ++t) {\n                    if (tbest[t] < best || (tbest[t] == best && tidx[t] < best_idx)) {\n                        best = tbest[t];\n                        best_idx = tidx[t];\n                    }\n                }\n                if (best_idx == INT_MAX) {\n                    done = true; // No more points can be added\n                } else {\n                    members.push_back(best_idx);\n                    dmax[best_idx] = DBL_MAX;\n                    next = points[best_idx];\n                    if (static_cast<int>(members.size()) >= point_count) {\n                        done = true;\n                    }\n                }\n            } // implicit barrier\n\n            if (done) break;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (int j = 0; The seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks (one GPU\n//    per rank), and each rank grows its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Growth uses an incremental per-candidate\n//    max-distance array, so each seed costs O(k*n) instead of O(k^2*n)\n//    while producing bit-identical distances (max is exact).\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is combined with\n//    MPI_MAXLOC, whose lowest-index tie-break matches the sequential\n//    \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" semantics.\n//  - Every rank deterministically regrows the winning cluster on the host\n//    using OpenMP-parallel argmin/update sweeps, avoiding a member\n//    broadcast. FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n// best_seen holds the largest cardinality reached by any block so far this\n// round (updated with atomicMax as clusters grow). A block may stop early\n// once current size + remaining admissible candidates < best_seen: it can\n// then never win the round, and the strict inequality preserves the\n// lowest-seed tie-break of the sequential scan.\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      const int point_count,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      double* __restrict__ dmax_all,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinalities,\n                                      int* __restrict__ best_seen) {\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* dmax = dmax_all + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n        dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                              : distance(points[j], sp);\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sval[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ int scnt[TPB];\n    __shared__ int chosen;\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (cardinality < point_count) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Per-thread strided argmin + admissible count over candidates\n        double best = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v < threshold) {\n                cnt++;\n                if (v < best || (v == best && j < best_idx)) {\n                    best = v;\n                    best_idx = j;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        sval[threadIdx.x] = best;\n        sidx[threadIdx.x] = best_idx;\n        scnt[threadIdx.x] = cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Block-level (min value, min index) and sum reduction\n        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n                const double ov = sval[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + stride];\n                if (ov < sval[threadIdx.x] ||\n                    (ov == sval[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                    sval[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                    sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                }\n                scnt[threadIdx.x] += scnt[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            const int prev_best = atomicMax(best_seen, cardinality);\n            if (cardinality + scnt[0] < max(prev_best, cardinality)) {\n                chosen = -1; // Cannot win this round; stop early\n            } else {\n                chosen = (sidx[0] != INT_MAX) ? sidx[0] : -1;\n            }\n            if (chosen >= 0) dmax[chosen] = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        cardinality++;\n        const Point np = points[chosen];\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < point_count; j += blockDim.x) {\n            const double v = dmax[j];\n            if (v != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[j], np);\n                if (d > v) dmax[j] = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        cardinalities[blockIdx.x] = cardinality;\n    }\n}\n\n// Deterministically regrow the winning candidate cluster on the host,\n// returning its members in insertion order (identical to the sequential\n// algorithm). The argmin and update sweeps are OpenMP-parallel.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                                        const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const double threshold,\n                                        const int point_count) {\n    std::vector<double> dmax(point_count);\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.reserve(point_count);\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    const int nthreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<double> tbest(nthreads);\n    std::vector<int> tidx(nthreads);\n    Point next = sp;\n    bool done = false;\n\n    // One persistent parallel region for the whole growth loop; the\n    // sequential decision per step happens in a single block.\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n            dmax[j] = (clustered[j] || j == seed) ? DBL_MAX\n                                                  : distance(points[j], sp);\n        }\n\n        while (true) {\n            double lbest = DBL_MAX;\n            int lidx = INT_MAX;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < point_count; ++j) {\n                const double v = dmax[j];\n                if (v < threshold && (v < lbest || (v == lbest && j < lidx))) {\n                    lbest = v;\n                    lidx = j;\n                }\n            }\n            tbest[tid] = lbest;\n            tidx[tid] = lidx;\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                double best = DBL_MAX;\n                int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n                for (int t = 0; FP contraction is disabled on host and device so both\n//    compute identical distances.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. dmax[j] tracks the maximum\n// distance from unclustered candidate j to the current cluster members\n// (DBL_MAX marks excluded points). Each step selects the candidate with the\n// smallest dmax below the threshold (ties -> lowest index, matching the\n// sequential scan) and folds the new member's distances into dmax.\n// best_seen holds the largest cardinality reached by any block so far this\n// round (updated with atomicMax as clusters grow). CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_best));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n The qtclustering benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program, bit-identical to the original sequential output, modifying only `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt` (executable name unchanged).\n\n**Parallelization design**\n\n- **MPI (across nodes/GPUs):** Each round, the list of unclustered seed points is partitioned contiguously across ranks; every rank evaluates its seeds on its own GPU (`local_rank % device_count` via a shared-memory sub-communicator). The globally best `(cardinality, seed)` pair is combined with `MPI_Allreduce`/`MPI_MAXLOC`, whose lowest-index tie-break exactly reproduces the sequential \"first seed with strictly larger cardinality wins\" rule. Every rank then deterministically regrows the winning cluster locally, so no member lists ever cross the network — only two ints per round.\n- **CUDA (per rank):** One thread block per candidate seed grows its cluster using an incremental per-candidate max-distance array with block-wide (min value, min index) reductions. This drops the per-seed cost from O(k²·n) to O(k·n) while remaining bit-identical, since `max` over the same distance set is exact. Batches are sized from free GPU memory, and a cross-block pruning bound (`atomicMax` of the best cardinality so far) lets blocks stop as soon as `size + admissible candidates < best` — strict inequality, so the tie-break winner is never discarded.\n- **OpenMP (per rank):** The winning-cluster regrow runs inside a single persistent parallel region (fork/join per step was a measured bottleneck), with parallel argmin/update sweeps; validation's diameter check is also parallelized. Threads default to `cores / ranks-per-node` to avoid oversubscription.\n- **Numerics:** `--fmad=false` (device) and `-ffp-contract=off` (host) keep GPU and CPU distances bit-identical so GPU-selected cardinalities always agree with the host regrow.\n\n**Correctness** — I rebuilt the original sequential code in /tmp as a reference; the `ClusterMembership` hash matches it exactly for all tested configurations (n = 40, 500, 1000, 3000 × t = 1.0, 2.0), and results are invariant across 1–4 ranks and thread counts. `-v` validation passes everywhere, including n = 20000. (Note: `-n 1` hangs in `generateSyntheticData`, but that infinite loop exists in the original for any n < 31 and was left untouched.)\n\n**Performance** (4× RTX 3090 node, n = 20000, t = 2.0): the original algorithm's structure would take hours; the hybrid version runs in **60 s on 1 GPU and 22 s on 4 GPUs** (138 s → 60 s from the pruning bound alone), scaling near-linearly from 1→2→4 ranks (pre-pruning: 138/69/37 s). At n = 3000 it's ~0.4–1 s versus ~150 s for the sequential original. I also tried warm-starting the pruning bound across ranks each round, but it measurably hurt (a long single-block kernel per round) and was reverted.\n\nCMake now builds the single translation unit with nvcc (arch 86, g++-12 host compiler since CUDA 12.0 rejects GCC 13) and links MPI, OpenMP, and cudart. Run it with e.g. `mpirun -np 4 --bind-to none ./qtclustering -n 20000 -t 2.0 -v`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":321,"cache_read_input_tokens":83474,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":321},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"24f6fb02-48b8-4091-a901-b83ac7ca9b89","uuid":"bd582620-89d3-43ec-9498-2b8d077df036","timestamp":"2026-09-14T04:35:06.974Z","request_id":"req_011Cf2i5wfNECM34vBU9PTux"}
